semantics.allocation_counter: Atomic process-local 32-bit allocation counter. Wrap, reload and context lifetime require host epoch; it is not a campaign identity.
semantics.source_key: UI and shared audio timing correlate by source+0x4c; not interchangeable with source allocation counter.
semantics.segment: Selected by current time in [row+0x120,row+0x124); same source can yield several segments. Text equality cannot identify an occurrence.
semantics.completion: Source expiry current>=duration is insufficient: audio timing loss can force current=duration. UI removal also covers option filtering. No completed/interrupted flag proven.
semantics.speaker: Source resource provides speaker localization key; UI may omit it when speaker display is disabled and the line is not forced.
semantics.presentation: Only the selected current segment is eligible. Active resource presence, audio posted/playing status and UI fact assignment do not prove on-screen visibility or audibility.
semantics.context: No campaign/save lineage established here. Time is source-relative and can be audio-driven; not a verified global simulation timestamp.

ui_contract.visibility_warning: HUD parent and renderer presentation acknowledgements still need tracing; model values may be hidden.

required_before_runtime: Dispatcher phase/lifetime and thread observation proof
Allocation wrap and world/context epoch behavior
Explicit successful end versus stop/cancel producer
Render presentation acknowledgement and subtitle-disabled audio eligibility
Semantic campaign identity and simulation clock correlation
qualification_cases: Repeated identical lines and overlapping speakers
Multiple timed segments under one source allocation
Subtitles disabled, forced subtitle, speaker names disabled and hidden HUD
Paused time, scene transition, reload and capture overflow

end_reason_followup.limitation: Stop is queued intent, not an acknowledged end event. Trace queue consumption and successful playback completion before assigning interruption reasons.

runtime_evidence.scope: Bounded native selected-segment observations on this executable fingerprint.
runtime_evidence.finding: Changed-result invocations produced copied nonempty selected segments and empty selections. Empty selections are rejected as text samples; they do not identify why a line ended.
limitations: Selected model text is not proof of final rendering or audibility.
Speaker identity, completion and cancellation remain unqualified.
An observation log ending with active totals does not establish clean observer shutdown.
